topic: Myth: cross-platform apps are always slow
caption:
Myth: “Cross-platform apps are always slow.” 🐢

Modern frameworks like React Native power smooth, fast apps on both iOS and Android from a single codebase.

When an app feels slow, the cause is usually how it was built: oversized images, too many network calls, heavy screens doing too much at once. Those problems slow native apps down too.

Native still wins for some cases, like heavy graphics or deep hardware work. For most business apps, good engineering matters more than the framework.

Agree or disagree? Tell us in the comments. 👇
